{{Quote|Here, in my laboratory, I had refined certain... devices. I could give one chosen apprentice decades of experience in a day. An apprentice, to become worthy to carry my vision.|Rajivari's Force ghost|audio=Rajivari-Laboratory-TOR.flac|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
The '''Fount of Rajivari''' was the first incarnation of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], originating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].

==History==
Constructed by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rajivari]], the Fount was the first collection of knowledge established by the fledgling [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The dream of Rajivari, one of the first members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], the Fount was established deep within the ruins of a [[ruined Tythonian city]] on the planet and known only to the Master's most trusted students. A massive construct of computers and [[Memory bank/Legends|databanks]], the Fount was attended to by Rajivari's [[Lore Keeper]]s who maintained the knowledge stored within.<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

When the [[Force Wars]] ravaged Tython and Rajivari perished, his [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] lingered behind, tending to the machinery and preserving the knowledge for centuries. Long after the Force Wars, the Jedi Order returned to Tython during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. As the Order reestablished its temples on the world, a young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] later known as the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] went in search of the Fount in an attempt to claim its wisdom. Following clues left by Rajivari himself on the [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]] of an ancient artifact known as the [[First Blade]], the Padawan was able to locate the Fount and the lingering spirit of Rajivari in the chambers deep under the ruined acropolis of the city.<ref name="SWTOR" />
